title: Use Your Good Understanding to Discern Truth from Falsehoo
body:
Yaa Rabbee! Allah, Allah. (Mawlana Shaykh stands) laa laa ilaaha illa-Llah, laa ilaaha illa-Llah, laa ilaaha illaLlah, Sayyidina wa Nabiyyina wa Mawlana Muhammadun Rasoolullah sallallahu `alayhi wa sallam. Zidhu
yaa Rabbee `izzan wa sharafan nooran wa suroora wa ridwaana wa sultaanan. Zid saa'iri 'l-anbiya wa 'lawliya wa `ibaadika 's-saaliheen, yaa Rabbana. Ij`alnaa tahta ajnihatihim yaa Rabbana yaa Allah, nahnu
`abeeduka ad-du`afa. Subhaan Sen, Sultaan Sen, `Aleem Sen, Haleem Sen, Ghafoor Sen, Raheem Sen. Yaa
Rabbana, yaa rabb ighfir wa 'rham wa anta khayru 'r-raahimeen. A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani ‘rrajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem. (Mawlana Shaykh sits) Huuuuuuu, Huuuuuuu, Huuuuuu,
Huuuuuuuu, Huuuuuuuuuuu, Huuuuuuuuu Allaaaah. Allaaaah Huuuuuuuuuuuuuu, Huuuu,
Huuuuuuuuuuuuuuu, Huuuuuuuuu, Huuuuuuuuuuuuuuu.
As-salaamu `alaykum, Saahib az-Zamaan. As salaamu `alaykum, yaa Qutb al-Mutasarrif. As salaamu
`alaykum, yaa Saahib az-Zamaan. As-salaamu `alaykum yaa `ibaadAllah as-saaliheen! Who asks the
pleasure of our Lord, Almighty Allah, as salaamu `alaykum, heavenly salute to you, that you are always
asking ridwaanullah. You are running after the pleasure of your Creator, your Lord's pleasure. Huuuuu,
Huuuuuu. To give our Lord pleasure, to make Him pleased with us. He is Allah, Jalla Jalaaluh `Adhaamatu .
He is Allah (swt)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands) From pre-Eternal up to Eternal, He is never changing, nothing

affects Him! (Mawlana Shaykh sits) He is the Lord, The Unchangeable One, Allah! Laa yughayyiruhu 'lhawaadith. What Mankind does has no affect on Him! He is Allah! Subhaan Sen. (Mawlana Shaykh stands
and sits) And endless pleasures to Your most glorified one, Your absolute deputy, Sayyidina Muhammad (s)!
(Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits).
O Salafi `ulamas! What is your belief about Isra` wal Laylat al-Mi`raaj, the Night Journey and Ascension?
The Seal of Prophets (s), the most beloved, most honored, most praised, most glorified one, went up. Who
called him? What is your `aqeedah, belief about that very important point?
O Attenders! As-salaamu `alaykum. Keep quiet and give all your dikkat, full attention to what is coming now.
Don't say, "We know everything," because We know nothing! I am now speaking and addressing those people
who claim, "We are Salafi `ulamas." `Ulamas must know a lot of things. They say to a person who may know
a few things, "You know something." We need to know and we live for knowing. What is your opinion, O
Salafi `ulamas? What are we living for, to build Nimrod towers? Are we living to save millions or billions of
paper money or heaps of gold? Are we living to have territories, or to have ships, to have planes, to have
children? Say! For what are we living, O Wahhabi, no-mind people? We are speaking Truth, but your pride is
so strong and you are never leaving it to say, "That servant is speaking the Truth." Say! For what have we
been created? Say! Have we been created to collect this dirty life's aspects? Is that why we have been created?
Say,"That shaykh is a liar, he is not speaking the truth." If you say that, a fire may come on your head tonight
and in the morning you will be getting out as a burned, a dead body!
This is not coming from me, but this is the power and might of heavenly ones, because they are angry with
Wahhabi people for going beyond limits! Their claims are not usual, and they pass their limits and attack
weak ones, but in the Heavens those are powerful ones! Here they are very weak ones, such that you are
looking at them and saying, “We are so powerful and he is so weak, and we can easily take him away." If you
can take away that pig virus, then you can take this one away also. Can you do that? Which one of you can
claim to stop that virus? You can’t do anything! You think I am an old man and it is easy to take me away. No,
you can't. If I am protected, you can't do anything, and if you are intending to do something to harm me, you
can't do it. Even your armies, air forces, your king's or sultan's dunya can't do anything to my weak body! If I
am a liar, it would be easy for you. But if they are making me to speak the Truth, you can't do anything. They
are making me sit here for a half-hour or one hour, making me address all people from east to west, from

north to south. Habbaytum, whether you are accepting it or not! Taqbalu aw lam taqbalu, whether you accept
it or not, no harm will come on me!
O People! Be careful, and use your good face, your good understanding. Give a chance to a weak servant. Ask,
"What is that weak servant's talab; what is he asking?" Why are they making me sit here? For what? Do you
think I am asking to be shaykh ul-Islam? Do you think I am asking to be an amir or malik, or this or that? No.
What is written for me reaches me, and not beyond that. I am 90 years old, so what am I asking? One cup of
soup is enough for me now. I have lived long years. What happened; what has stayed with me? I may ask
about all these years, what benefit came to me?
O People! You must be of those with good understanding. Bad understanding is ignorance, and ignorance is
from Shaytan.
O Salafi `ulamas! Say, didn't Shaytan know about Adam (a)? He knew, but he was aneed, stubborn. He
represents all shaytanic characters; that is what makes Shaytan. He knew about Adam, peace be upon him.
Now Wahhabi people, do you not know about this weak servant? Don't be like Shaytan, proud and pretending
you don't know. You know this servant is speaking the Truth! And Allah Almighty is saying: (Mawlana
Shaykh stands)
••• •••••••• ••••••••• •••••••• ••••••••• •••••• •••••••••• •••• •••••••••••
Yaa ayyuha 'Lladheena `aamanoo ittaqoollah wa koonoo ma` as-saadiqeen. O you who believe! Fear Allah
and be with those who are true (in word and deed). (at-Tawbah, 9:119)
(Mawlana Shaykh sits) What is your opinion? Are you following that order of Allah, to be with saadiqeen,
true ones? I am asking mulook also, which true one are you sitting with to take advice from? Who are your
advisors? True ones? Even your conscience never accepts those whom you ask, because they are always
asking for dunya, those greedy people surrounding kings and mulook, sultans and `umaraas. And you are
accepting them as your advisors. No, you must find true ones to be your advisors! If not, some cursing may
fall on you, and no one will be able to help you. Twenty-first century people's main advisor is Shaytan and its
agents, as they are not asking for true ones. Therefore, cursing falls on them like rain!
O Listeners! This is an ummaan, ocean, coming daily in another type of speech, and it will never end, so don't

worry. It is not a mindly production, no; it is heavenly, never-ending. If dunya could be up to Eternity, daily
you would fall into the nets of Shaytan and its agents!
May Allah forgive us for the honor of Sayyidina Muhammad (s) in this holy month. (Mawlana Shaykh stands
and sits) Astaghfirullah.
(30 minutes) (874 viewers) Alhamdulillah, alhamdulillah, alhamdulillah, yaa Rabbee!
(Mawlana Shaykh prays two raka`at Salaat ash-Shukr.)
Fatihah.
(Mawlana Shaykh speaks with Shaykh Hisham Effendi on the phone.)
